pending-clause.answer: The flag fires on the word 'terminates' ('when the ACCEPT terminates') (the table's invokes pattern 'run unit|initial state|terminat|transfer of control'); here it means the end of one ACCEPT screen statement (function key or normal termination key), not run unit termination (§2002:14.5.10), initial state (§2002:14.5.2.1.2.1) or the flow-of-control mechanism (§2002:14.5.3), whose differing text (communication-section initialization, MCS purge, paragraph vs procedure wording, declaratives vs exception procedures) the rule does not rest on. The construct is the declined screen ACCEPT, refused at --std 2002 with no code produced (§2002:3.1.5), so scope and evidence are unchanged.
